canonical_name: Improvements Not Identified from Operational Execution
description: Improvements are not identified from execution of operational processes.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Continuous improvement and process optimization teams Security testing and assessment functions Organizations conducting lessons learned activities

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for lack of operational metrics review, absence of process improvement initiatives, failure to document operational inefficiencies or gaps, or missing feedback mechanisms from day-to-day security operations teams.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls
